featured_reviews.name: Amit Agrawal
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Escapeverse and chose the "Murder on Eclipse Express" room. Based on the marketing and hype around their use of advanced technology and sensors, I had high expectations. Unfortunately, the experience did not justify the price we paid.

While the room does use a few sensors and automated mechanisms to unlock doors, the technology itself is quite limited and does not significantly enhance the gameplay. The "latest technology" claim feels exaggerated compared to what is actually offered inside the room.

The biggest disappointment was the storyline. As a murder mystery-themed escape room, I expected a logical and engaging investigation. Instead, many of the conclusions required players to make unrealistic assumptions, and the story progression often felt disconnected from the clues provided. Rather than rewarding logical thinking, several puzzles seemed to rely on guesswork. A good escape room should make players feel like detectives solving a mystery, but that feeling was largely missing here.

The room theme was "Murder on Eclipse Express," yet there was very little that made us feel like we were actually on a train. The ambience, setup, and overall immersion did not effectively support the theme. The train environment felt underdeveloped, which made it harder to connect with the story.

Another point worth mentioning is the room size. The space is quite limited and is best suited for 2–3 participants. Larger groups may find it cramped, with some members having little to do during certain parts of the game.

The overall condition of the premises was also disappointing. If you visit, I would recommend using the lift instead of the stairs, as the staircase were dirty and lighting was not there during our visit. Additionally, there were ants outside the room entrance, and some even got into my shoes, causing discomfort after leaving from venue. Basic cleanliness and hygiene around the venue should be maintained more carefully though inside cleanliness was good.

Finally, I was surprised by the handling of the payment receipt. After making payment, I requested a receipt but was initially told it could not be provided. It was only shared the following day via WhatsApp. A receipt should ideally be issued immediately upon payment.

Overall, I found Escapeverse to be significantly overhyped. The technology, storyline, immersion, venue maintenance, and customer service did not meet expectations for the amount charged. There is definitely room for improvement, particularly in creating a more logical story, enhancing the thematic experience, maintaining better hygiene, and providing a smoother customer experience.

featured_reviews.name: Deepika Pote
featured_reviews.review_text:
There are moments in life when your mind feels trapped in an endless loop of thoughts… when problems don’t just stay outside, they follow you everywhere. That’s exactly where we were... when we decided to try the Kohinoor room at Mystery Room, Andheri West..
and honestly, we didn’t realize then how much we needed it.
From the moment we entered, the energy shifted. The staff welcomed us with such warmth..always smiling, patient, and genuinely excited for us. It didn’t feel like just another activity; it felt like someone quietly telling us, “You’re going to feel better here.”
And then the game began.
What I loved the most was how brilliantly the clues were designed...hilarious, clever, and surprisingly nostalgic.. It was a reminder ...It felt like everything I had ever studied, observed, or casually learned in life was suddenly coming together. Each puzzle wasn’t just a task...it was a spark. A distraction. A reminder that the mind can still play, think, and solve… even when it feels heavy.
There were moments we laughed uncontrollably...cant tell you d exact details , moments we got stuck, and moments where we just looked at each other and said, “Wait… could it be this?” And when things started clicking, it wasn’t just about solving the room...it felt like breaking through something inside us. We dint panic ,got angry, or blamed each other but were focused on problem solving..
And then… that bell rang.
That sound ..it wasn’t just a signal that we had completed the task in hand... It was a jolt.... The exact jolt we didn’t know we needed... For those few minutes, we weren’t thinking about stress, worries, or anything weighing us down. We were just present, quick..and connected... We dint think ... We just did what needed to be done ..and laughed out our hearts....
We walked out lighter. Clearer. Almost reset.
If you’re feeling stuck, overwhelmed, or just mentally exhausted, this place is more than just an escape room. It’s a pause. A shift. A small but powerful break from the chaos inside your head.
For me and my sister, it wasn’t just an experience...it was a moment of healing.
A must-visit. Truly one of the best experiences we’ve ever had.

featured_reviews.name: Prachi Biyani
featured_reviews.review_text:
I went to Bhandardara for the fireflies festival not knowing what to expect. I came back with one of the best weekends of my life.

The trip was special not just because of the destination, but because of the people, the group, the conversations, the memories made along the way. That kind of experience doesn't happen by accident.

Our team leaders Sohil sir, Vinay sir, and Ahbas sir made sure no one felt left out, ever. From ice-breaking games on the bus to bonfire stories under the stars, there was never a dull moment. They ran a seamless two days- smooth, organised, and genuinely fun.

The campsite was well-maintained and hygienic, with easy access to washrooms and a restaurant. One tent for two people, comfort was clearly a priority.

The night trek to the fireflies was the highlight for most, and for good reason. Sohil sir made sure everyone reached the peak safely, and when we got there, it felt like a movie. Watching the fireflies glow across the valley, holding one in your hand... that's a once-in-a-lifetime moment. We even got to click pictures with them, thanks to a local who helped us out.

Food was homelike and hearty- roti sabzi and rice for dinner, poha and bread butter for breakfast, and a lunch stop at Shiv Sagar on the road.

But honestly? The return journey might have been the highlight. We played Mafia on the bus back to Mumbai, full bus participation, absolute chaos, core memory unlocked. We also made a reel. Obviously.

If you're looking for a trip that's well-organised AND actually fun, Adventure Geek delivers. Special mention to Vinay sir and Sohil sir, you made this one unforgettable.

highly recommend. 10/10

featured_reviews.name: Riya Kadav
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ll start with the bad pointers. This was my 3rd time staying at the property and this time was my worst experience there. Earlier the rooms and bathrooms used to be pretty clean and the ac were working but this time it was a disaster.
1. Our bathroom was a mess with water splatter everywhere & leaky jet-spray.
2. Our Ac wasn’t working so we called room service but still it kept turning off after 10-15 mins so finally they changed rooms at 8pm and the other room was fine but there were cigarette buds lying in the balcony so it was not cleaned all the way through.
3. We ordered room service food for lunch+dinner+snacks and so many times we had to ask for enough of cups and plates and cutlery. I can still excuse this if there are a lot of guests but I thought of mentioning because it’s basic service you can expect to receive.
4. They even charged us for water bottles that were provided to us in the rooms.

Talking about the good pointers— The rest of the services were fine like when we asked for extra bedding they were prompt and even the room service meals arrived within 30-40 mins. The view and location is great.

My first 2 experiences staying at this property was pretty nice so I came back again this time but I’m highly disappointed. I like the property so I hope they take this review seriously and improve

customer_updates.name: Madhuri
customer_updates.text:
Me and my husband opted for a 24 hours stay at this resort, a few days back only.

PROS :-
Hospitality & Food - both were good.
Behaviour and care of the staff members were good and comfortable to stay and enjoy in this resort for a 24 hours stay option.
The swimming pool is well maintained and periodically cleaned also - good chillout pool side party with loud music of own choice enhances the thrill to stay and enjoy in this resort.

CONS :- (Video is attached)
Indoor games are not well maintained at all - mentioned in the feedback form of the resort as well so that it can be well taken care of, by the management, in the future for sports lovers like us (me & my husband) !

Carrom board is broken/damaged - unplayable.
The pool table is dirty/rough - unplayable.
Table Tennis board alignment is lost/damaged -  unplayable.
Table Soccer is also unplayable as the  sticks are rusted and hence tough/hard  to move/play - unplayable.
Chess and Ludo/snake-ladder games are okay only, as they were glass protected  - hence only playable indoor games at the moment.

Outdoor games :-
The rainy season is not for outdoor games at any resort, when it comes to our 24 hour relaxation choice of recreation !!

Overall - A very good place to hangout, the scenic view and the beauty of the resort decoration is awesome !

featured_reviews.name: Ritesh Arekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am very disappointed with the food service at this resort. The resort mentions unlimited food and snacks, but in reality the quantity served was very limited. Many guests had to repeatedly request food and snacks, which should not happen when it is advertised as unlimited.

The food management was also very poor and unorganized. I personally witnessed many people asking for coffee, but the staff kept saying that the coffee was finished and that tea would be ready later, asking everyone to wait. This happened multiple times and created a lot of inconvenience for guests.

In addition to this, the taste and quality of the food were not good. When we pay a good amount for a resort stay, we expect decent food quality and proper service. Unfortunately, that expectation was not met.

I strongly suggest the management improve:

Food quality and taste
Proper quantity as promised
Better food planning and management

Availability of items like coffee and snacks without unnecessary delays.

Overall, the resort experience was affected mainly because of poor food service, and I hope the management takes this feedback seriously and improves in the future.

featured_reviews.name: ZubaiR ShaikH
featured_reviews.review_text:
Yesterday I visited  *Ocean Hills Pereira Farms* along with 23 students and my wife 😊

Overall, the place is excellent and very well maintained. Some highlights:

• Excellent environment for children 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦
• Beautiful natural surroundings 🌿
• Well-designed and well-built villas 🏡
• Very good breakfast, lunch, and evening snacks 🍽️
• Amazing cleanliness across the villa and entire property ✨
• Staff is very friendly and supportive 👍

*A small point:*

• The play zone was under renovation, which was a bit disappointing 😕

• The cricket/football turf can be a game-changer if proper grass is added and the top net is fully covered ⚽🏏

☠️*However, there is one serious health concern that needs immediate attention* ⚠️

• The private villa swimming pool has extremely high chlorine levels
• The water tasted very bitter — unlike any pool I have experienced before 🤢
• Within 20 minutes, students started experiencing burning in their eyes 😣
• Many students developed red eyes 🔴 and continuous irritation
• By evening, several students including me had blurred vision 👀
• Two students had to visit an eye doctor the Today 🏥

🚨*THIS IS A SERIOUS HEALTH HAZARD*🚨

I strongly request the caretaker, management, and owner to immediately check and correct the chlorine levels in the pool to prevent any further harm 🙏

Overall, the experience was good and the place has great potential 🌟
I would love to visit again.

However, due to this safety issue, I cannot confidently recommend it until the pool water is properly maintained.
